title: Constraint equations for the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_constraints
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry) :
    ∃ data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry,
      Nonempty (CompletedTensorCommonLiftConstraints l X R closed models symmetry
        data.tensor data.unit)

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; common-field tensor descent.

proof.text: Construct a tensorator and unit together with the literal common-component normalization using completed_tensor_common_lift_normalized_tensor_unit.

Apply the associativity theorem to those data and the constructed normalization; apply the existing left-unit, right-unit and symmetry declarations to the same data. Package the four equations and return the data together with the constraints. No law for an arbitrary unrelated tensorator or unit is asserted.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15, the actual tensor functor, together with HRS Lemma 7.9 (literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf), the natural finite-field colimit equivalence; the explicit component construction already present in AdicCompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit.

statement_change.what: The old wrapper universally quantified over arbitrary tensor and unit comparisons. Replace this false universal normalization assertion by existence of data satisfying the constraint equations; construct the tensorator with the explicit normalized components. Its sole consumer already needs only existence of a coherent tensorator, and keeps its original signature.
